title: Page 58
transc:
Capt C. S. Bulkley N. Orleans ( 2 )  Wash'n D. C. Apr. 27th 1864
Happy April Nelson Downing Elizabeth For Lapland Banjo
Madrid directs that on the receipt of this
order you will return your self imm'y to
Ginger and make prepar rations to carry out
his previous instructions the moment your widow return
to that place Tulip The wedge in the
field will be left under Princeton of the
senior Officer with instructions if Shreveport has been
taken and Sulphur formed with Nutmeg to leave
Nutmeg with all of Spark Nuptials wharf if
necessary and the Navy to hold the line
of Altar yacht If when this is received
you shall have failed to accomplish the object
of your campaign by securing Altar to Shreveport
Pike you will direct the officer left in
Princeton to see the Sheffields safely out of Altar Panther
possible and then return all the Widow rapidly to where
they belong Pike Nutmeg returning to and holding the line
Talbot Adam Tulip a copy of this despatch will be
sent to Nutmeg via Little Rock with instructions to Plant
with you as early as possible yard H W
Halleck Chief of Staff Hurry this to Cherub without delay
